brief: Goldman's FICC and Equities desk reports US stocks higher at mid-day on 11 September 2026, NDX above SPX above RTY, breadth better than yesterday at 350 names green, despite August core CPI at +0.29% m/m versus +0.2% expected, with telephone services and travel the firmest components. The desk's chain: the hotter print raised September hike odds to about 85%, and pricing that certainty in September could rip the band aid off, with focus shifting to next Wednesday's 2pm ET FOMC meeting. Semis and AI led, SMH +2%, NDX +1.1%, the GSTMTAIP index +2%, while ORCL and ADBE round-tripped pre-market strength to unchanged and software lagged, which the desk attributes to macro wrong-way positioning rather than the morning's single-stock headlines. Oil kept retreating on a scheduled Oman meeting next week between Iranian officials and GCC ministers. Franchise activity is 4 out of 10 with balanced flows, long-onlys 12% better for sale, hedge funds 1.7% better for sale, ETFs 32% of tape, CTAs modeled to sell $30mm in a flat one-week tape. Huang reiterated $3-4tn of AI infrastructure spending by 2030.
